description: The I-O-CONTROL APPLY COMMIT clause (ISO §2023:12.4.6.3) and with it the COMMIT and ROLLBACK statements it gives effect to (§2023:14.9.7, §2023:14.9.36) — the commit and rollback facility, a COBOL-2023 introduction (§2023:E.3.2 item 2). Provided for RELATIVE and INDEXED files (kb/Work PB3337, PB3338; docs/CONFORMANCE.md §5, A.4.3 Partial). The ISO/IEC 1989:2002 and 2014 I-O-CONTROL formats have no APPLY clause (nor the 85 format); the grammar is the union, so below 2023 VersionConformancePass names the edition on recognition (COBOL0900; kb/Work PB5025). COMMIT and ROLLBACK are user-defined words below 2023 (user-word-commit-2023).
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. ACC.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT RELF ASSIGN TO "acc.dat"
        ORGANIZATION IS RELATIVE
        RELATIVE KEY IS RK.
I-O-CONTROL.
    APPLY COMMIT ON RELF.
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD RELF.
01 RREC PIC X(10).
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 RK PIC 9(4).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    STOP RUN.
